title: onboard-spectral-11b-v1.0-performance-profiles-changelog-automation
author: Alyssa Chen
release_notes: Added Spectral-11B v1.0 to model registry with performance profiles and automated changelog generation. Performance profiles include fp16 and int8-quantized measurements across common batch/seq-lengths. No breaking changes.
description: Onboard Spectral-11B v1.0: adds model metadata, performance profiles (fp16 + int8), and automation to generate changelog entries for new registry models. Motivation: Spectral-11B has shown good cost/latency tradeoffs for mid-range conversational workloads and should be available in the catalog with verified perf characteristics. This PR bundles three things: 1) model metadata and tags (hardware compatibility, tokenizer, size, license), 2) perf profiles collected from our perf lab (throughput/latency matrices for common batch size / seq length combinations), and 3) a small automation hook that appends a standardized entry to the model-registry CHANGELOG.md when a model is merged so release notes are no longer a manual step.
commits:
1) Add spectral-11b v1.0 metadata and README
2) Add perf profiles (fp16, int8) and test harness config
3) Add gen-changelog script and CI integration
4) Update registry index and docs references
